<function name="IsOverlappingArea" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns true if this <page>CNavArea</page> is overlapping the given <page>CNavArea</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="navArea" type="CNavArea">The <page>CNavArea</page> to test against.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the given <page>CNavArea</page> overlaps this <page>CNavArea</page> at any point.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
